grammar.source_route: Owned276-byte descriptor with count1 context and count1 anchor; typed reciprocal support explicitly names historical source owner. Anchor names native BODY, which maps via an exact stored handle to typed initial ASM BODY in the explicitly referenced same-asset blob.
grammar.edge: Observed116-byte edge recipe shares the Pipe two-face/two-three-face-vertex operand grammar; final int32 may be0/-1 and is retained opaque. Observed120-byte circular variant retains its92-byte tail exactly without evaluating it.
grammar.vertex: Observed40-byte vertex recipe has int32direct-1,count3,three exact named-face operands and two storedzero fields. Reciprocal source vertex incidence must match the complete face triple uniquely.
grammar.selection: Exact complete name/index/counted-component tuples join to reciprocally owned generic-tag attributes. A unique edge has exactly the two named incident faces; endpoint triples identify ordered typed endpoint vertices. Vertex selections have exactly the three named incident faces. Geometry is inspected only after this identity joins.
grammar.secondary_context: Typed55/75-byte edge cache,103-byte circular cache or28-byte point cache stays separate. The75-byte projection route can already have an independently decoded secondary naming link; this primary-recipe join does not replace it.

limitations: A matching named face pair does not guarantee a currently surviving edge. Chamfer/Fillet remove the selected edge and alter the same native BODY; current-cache absence is not permission to choose a nearby edge or replay unqualified trailing records.
Some modified Fillet bodies include unsupported cached topology/geometry. Their incomplete coverage blocks uniqueness claims and remains unresolved.

Only observed identity-transform initial BODY topology, single edge Line/Circle and vertex three-face operands are admitted. Surface-boundary recipe families and generic-tag layouts outside the existing strict reader remain unresolved.
The edge operation final0/-1 field is opaque. Circular92-byte operation qualifiers, context geometry, historical-state replay, universal persistent topology and regeneration remain unresolved.
Projected-source cache retains source z=2 while captured projected output lies at z=0. Output coordinates do not select source identity and do not substitute for the actual unprojected source.

AtCenter Hole fixture did not capture an actual BRepEdge getter; its selected source circle center is corroborated by the actual hole position and documented generator setup, not an invented source getter.
